source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
**EMPEROR’S CHILDREN** units of yours have **Sensational Performance**: each time the unit is picked to fight, if it made its Charge move earlier this turn, it may use this ability, and then for the rest of the phase:

- It may not target any unit it began the turn within Engagement Range of.
- It may not target a unit another unit has attacked this phase.
- Its melee weapons improve their Strength and Armour Penetration by 1.
